content: PostgREST PATCH with a filter against a table with an UPDATE policy but no SELECT policy silently matches ZERO rows: HTTP 204 with Content-Range */0, no error, no change. PostgreSQL CREATE POLICY docs: an UPDATE whose WHERE clause reads columns requires SELECT rights and SELECT/ALL policies in addition to UPDATE policies. Upsert (Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates) fails too with 42501. Fix: SECURITY DEFINER function called via POST /rest/v1/rpc/<name>.
